name: ScriptVmOpPushInt32
description: script VM op 0x29: reads u32 immediate, pushes typed value (type 1)

name: ScriptVmOpLoadVar
description: script VM op 0x3e: operand {u16 kind,u16 idx}, pushes variable (kind 1 = frame local)

name: ScriptVmOpStoreVar
description: script VM op 0x3d: operand {u16 kind,u16 idx}, pops into variable

name: ScriptVmOpSwitchTable
description: script VM op 0x35: u16 count then count*8-byte {u32 target,u16 type,u16 id} entries (resume/jump table)

name: ScriptVmOpFuncMarker
description: script VM op 0x3b: u16 symbol id marking a function/yield entry (id indexes the script name table)

name: ScriptVmOpPushIntBlock
description: script VM op 0x2c: u16 N then N*4 bytes inline, pushes N int values

name: ScriptVmOpPushFloatBlock
description: script VM op 0x2e: u16 N then N*4 bytes inline, pushes N float values

name: ScriptVmOpJumpCond24
description: script VM op 0x24: rel32 jump (conditional on popped value)

name: ScriptVmOpJump22
description: script VM op 0x22: rel32 jump (unconditional, skips function bodies)
